notes: First-pass concept, idle, walk and hurt for the female Elementalist are in rework-staging with technical QA. Runtime approval remains false pending the global cross-class art review.

Only the idle high-resolution original could be identified by exact source and archived canonically in this audit. Separate original hires sheets for the concept, walk and hurt were not found in the Library; those gaps are explicitly recorded rather than filled with artificial upscales.

Visual cross-class review: the purple Brujo, forest-green Cazador and lighter travel-green Explorer retain distinct palettes and silhouettes. The navy/ivory/gold Elementalist is visually distinct. Idle motion reads subtly in previews, so motion readability remains a candidate for the final polish pass; no completed class is being redone now.
